Charles worries that spreading effort across multiple customer groups will produce shallow learning across many customers rather than focused validation.
Charles explicitly forecasts the company burning through the requested $850k while pursuing an unfocused customer strategy.
Charles characterizes the combination of broad customer pursuit and shallow learning as a potential recipe for startup failure.
Charles asks the founders to identify the single customer segment they would prioritize, explicitly probing focus in the initial market entry path.
